description: The timer textbook in one program: a TON gives a 3-second purge delay after the motor starts; a TOF gives the exhaust fan a 3-second run-on after the motor stops. Read the bits as PurgeDelay.DN / FanRunOn.DN.
name: Fan & Purge Control

rungs.comment: Motor seal-in: (StartPB OR MotorRun) AND NOT StopPB
Purge timer: times while the motor runs
Purge-ready lamp follows the timer's DN bit
Fan run-on timer: input is the motor; DN holds through the run-on
Fan contactor follows the run-on timer's DN bit

tags.comment: TON: purge completes 3000 ms after motor start
tags.name: PurgeDelay

tags.comment: TOF: fan runs on 3000 ms after motor stop
tags.name: FanRunOn

tags.comment: Worst scan evaluation time since startup, microseconds
tags.name: MaxScanUs
